# ka-table

> Free and customizable React data grid with sorting, filtering, grouping, tree data, editing, paging, and virtual scrolling. MIT licensed; React 18 or 19 is the only peer dependency.

Version: 13.0.1.

## Machine-readable documentation

- [Complete Markdown reference](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/llms-full.txt): installation, usage, state rules, theming, generated API reference, actions, and links to every demo source.
- [Agent notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/komarovalexander/ka-table/master/scripts/package/AGENTS.md): concise integration rules and correct package imports.

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://ka-table.com/docs_get_started.html)
- [Table and column props](https://ka-table.com/docs_props.html)
- [UI customization](https://ka-table.com/docs_ui.html)
- [Actions and state](https://ka-table.com/docs_action.html)
- [Hooks and utilities](https://ka-table.com/docs_hooks_utils.html)
- [Migration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/komarovalexander/ka-table/master/MIGRATION.md)

## Essential examples

- [Overview](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/#/overview): basic table setup.
- [Editing](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/#/editing): cell editing.
- [Remote data](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/#/remote-data): server-controlled data.
- [Virtual scrolling](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/#/many-rows): large datasets.
- [Custom cell](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/#/custom-cell): component customization.
- [All examples and TSX sources](https://komarovalexander.github.io/ka-table/llms-full.txt#examples)
